task: Sweep remaining repos for 3D models; harden pipeline with free integrations

Audit the REMAINING mhvnsnt repos for 3D models/animation: Forge3D (3D generation repo — check), God-Molecule-Show-Studio, TRIPPEDD-Production-studios, texture-customizer, atlas, homefront, Moneymachine.
